description: Create a product category. Call get_categories FIRST — a second "Drinks" is easy to make and there is no merge. Pass parentId to make it a subcategory; leave it out for a top-level one. The cabinet's own form asks for a description, so ask the merchant for one rather than inventing it. This does NOT move any product into the category — do that with update_product and its categoryIds.

description.description: Short description shown in the cabinet

image.description: Image URL, or a Lucide icon reference like "lucide:coffee"

name.description: Category name as the merchant said it, e.g. "Beverages"

parentId.description: Parent category id from get_categories — a name is rejected. Omit for top level

sortOrder.description: Position among its siblings, lowest first. Omit to leave it unsorted

name: hub_create_category
title: Create category
